scope_out: approving a version from this UI (admin action, out of this story's scope_in)

operations.text:
- Step 1: write failing Vitest tests first in frontend/src/ui/pages/PolicyEditorPage.test.tsx and frontend/src/ui/components/ProductThresholdForm.test.tsx (AC2 inline min_age < max_age error disabling Save, AC3 Draft v2 confirmation and list refresh) and a Playwright viewport spec in e2e/policy-editor.spec.ts (AC1 375x812 single column, no horizontal scroll)
- Step 2: scaffold the Vite app entry in frontend/index.html, frontend/vite.config.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx and frontend/src/ui/App.tsx; add frontend/src/types/policy.ts for ProductRule and PolicyVersion; money values stay strings
- Step 3: add the typed API client in frontend/src/repository/apiClient.ts and frontend/src/repository/policiesRepo.ts (GET /api/policies, GET /api/products, POST /api/policies); nothing else calls fetch; never log application data
- Step 4: add hooks in frontend/src/service/usePolicies.ts (list, create draft) and frontend/src/service/policyValidation.ts (min_age < max_age and the other FA-F1.6 threshold checks mirrored for inline feedback only; the backend decides)
- Step 5: add frontend/src/ui/components/ProductThresholdForm.tsx and frontend/src/ui/pages/PolicyEditorPage.tsx following specs/design/mockups/E4-S2.html and specs/ui_spec.md (forms stack in one column on mobile, Save disabled while invalid, Draft v2 confirmation, version list)
